cues.en: Lecturer: The two sample t-test.
cues.zh: 講師：雙樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: This is my second favorite t-test after the one sample t-test.
cues.zh: 這是我第二喜歡的 t 檢定，僅次於單一樣本。

cues.en: So what we are going to do in this video is explore the two sample t-test in code in several different ways.
cues.zh: 這部影片會用程式，以幾種不同方式探索。

cues.en: So let's start by generating data.
cues.zh: 先產生資料。

cues.en: So I'm going to simulate a dataset with two groups and there's gonna be 30 data points in the first group and 40 data points in the second group.
cues.zh: 模擬兩組資料，第一組 30 個點，第二組 40 個。

cues.en: And then I'm gonna have the first group have a mean of one and the second group have a mean or population mean and expected value of 1.2.
cues.zh: 第一組平均值為 1，第二組平均，也就是母體平均、期望值，為 1.2。

cues.en: Of course the sample mean, the empirical mean of our sample is unlikely to be one in 1.2 just because of, you know, "sampling variability,"
cues.zh: 當然，因為抽樣變異，樣本的實驗平均值不太可能恰好是 1 和 1.2，

cues.en: which here I'm simulating as normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 這裡用常態分布隨機數模擬。

cues.en: Okay, and then we're gonna see their histograms and that's it for this first cell.
cues.zh: 再看直方圖，第一個儲存格就做這些。

cues.en: So I'm plotting these histograms on top of each other, which, as you know, I generally don't recommend.
cues.zh: 把直方圖疊在一起，你知道我通常不建議。

cues.en: It kind of works sometimes here because, well, just because there's only two data sets and there aren't so many bins.
cues.zh: 這裡有時可行，因為只有兩組，而且區間不多。

cues.en: In fact, you can see I'm using the Freedman-Diaconis rule here in both cases.
cues.zh: 兩組都使用 Freedman–Diaconis 規則。

cues.en: And so data one actually ended up being very small number of bins.
cues.zh: 結果第一組區間非常少。

cues.en: I'm not super happy about how that worked out, but, you know, that's what happens when you follow an algorithm.
cues.zh: 不太滿意，但照演算法就會這樣。

cues.en: But when you look at this plot, you certainly don't get the sense that these two distributions differ at all in their means.
cues.zh: 看這張圖，完全感覺不出兩個分布平均值有差。

cues.en: So they certainly don't look different.
cues.zh: 看起來肯定沒不同。

cues.en: Let's see what the t-statistic is.
cues.zh: 看看 t 統計量。

cues.en: So here I'm using ttest2.
cues.zh: 使用 ttest2。

cues.en: So two videos ago, for the one sample t-test, I was using the function ttest, And now we use ttest2 for a two sample t-test.
cues.zh: 前兩部單一樣本用 ttest，現在雙樣本用 ttest2。

cues.en: And you input the first dataset and the second dataset, and I'll show you some of these other additional inputs in a moment.
cues.zh: 輸入第一組、第二組資料，等一下展示其他額外輸入。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm just plotting.
cues.zh: 再畫圖。

cues.en: So the outputs are the same as for the one sample t-test.
cues.zh: 輸出和單一樣本相同。

cues.en: And then I'm just plotting a title which shows the t-value, the degrees of freedom and the T, yeah, the t-value here and the p-value.
cues.zh: 標題顯示 t 值、自由度，以及 t，對，t 值和 P 值。

cues.en: So not even remotely significant.
cues.zh: 完全不接近顯著。

cues.en: No, it's not so surprising.
cues.zh: 不意外。

cues.en: We can try generating this data again.
cues.zh: 再產生一次。

cues.en: Yeah, it doesn't look like we're gonna get really big effects.
cues.zh: 看起來不會有很大效果。

cues.en: Now, the reason why we're not getting a big effect is that the means differ by 0.2, but the variance, the standard deviation
cues.zh: 原因是，平均值差 0.2，但變異數、這些隨機數的標準差

cues.en: of these random numbers is one, which is actually five times bigger than these mean differences here.
cues.zh: 是 1，是平均差的五倍。

cues.en: So what I'm gonna do here is just decrease the "sampling variability" a little bit by just dividing the random numbers by 10.
cues.zh: 所以把隨機數除以 10，稍微減少「抽樣變異」。

cues.en: So you see, now we're starting to get somewhere.
cues.zh: 現在有進展了。

cues.en: Now this really looks like these two populations are different.
cues.zh: 看起來兩個母體真的不同。

cues.en: So let's see what these statistics tells us.
cues.zh: 看看統計怎麼說。

cues.en: Hmm, so the statistics tells us that the t-value is minus 8.7 and the p-value is one.
cues.zh: 嗯，t 值為 −8.7，而 P 值為 1。

cues.en: Now that seems really strange.
cues.zh: 這很奇怪。

cues.en: We can look at this p-value here, it is in fact one.
cues.zh: 看 P 值，確實是 1。

cues.en: That seems really bizarre because visually there's huge differences between these two distributions.
cues.zh: 非常奇怪，因為視覺上兩個分布差異巨大。

cues.en: And the t-value in terms of magnitude is really large.
cues.zh: t 值的絕對大小也很大。

cues.en: What in the world is going on here?
cues.zh: 到底怎麼回事？

cues.en: Why don't we have a significant p-value?
cues.zh: 為什麼 P 值不顯著？

cues.en: Well, what's going on here is I gave an optional, some optional additional inputs into the ttest2 function,
cues.zh: 原因是，我為 ttest2 提供了額外選用輸入，

cues.en: and I specified that the tail of this test is right.
cues.zh: 指定檢定尾部為 right。

cues.en: So that means we're only testing the right tail.
cues.zh: 也就是只檢驗右尾。

cues.en: Now notice that it's dataset two that has a larger mean, so it's pushed further to the right on the x-axis here.
cues.zh: 注意，第二組平均較大，所以在 X 軸上更靠右。

cues.en: But I'm inputting data1,data2.
cues.zh: 但輸入順序是 data1、data2。

cues.en: So MATLAB is actually computing the mean of data1 minus the mean of data2.
cues.zh: MATLAB 計算的是 data1 平均減 data2 平均。

cues.en: So that mean ends up being negative, which means it's all the way on the left of the distribution.
cues.zh: 差值為負，所以在分布很左邊。

cues.en: That's also obvious from looking at this t-value.
cues.zh: 從 t 值也很明顯。

cues.en: Minus eight is all the way on the left of the distribution.
cues.zh: −8 在分布最左側。

cues.en: So if you do a one-tailed test for just the right tail, then, yeah, it's obviously this is an accurate result.
cues.zh: 如果只做右尾單尾檢定，這顯然是準確結果。

cues.en: The p-value is really large, it's really close to one, but that doesn't necessarily mean that the effect is non-significant.
cues.zh: P 值很大、很接近 1，但不一定代表效果不顯著。

cues.en: It means that the effect is in the other direction, it's in the other tail.
cues.zh: 表示效果在另一方向、另一尾。

cues.en: So we can change this to how about both?
cues.zh: 可以改成 both。

cues.en: Now we do a two-tailed t-test and now you see this p-value is tiny, it's 1 times 10 to the minus 12.
cues.zh: 現在做雙尾，P 值極小，是 1×10 的 −12 次方。

cues.en: So it's really small.
cues.zh: 非常小。

cues.en: Also here I'm specifying that the vartype, so the variance type is equa.
cues.zh: 這裡指定 vartype，也就是變異數類型，為 equa。

cues.en: Now you might think that this is, you know, this might produce an error here because I should have written equal, but it turns out that in MATLAB, so MATLAB is generally only going to test
cues.zh: 也許覺得應該寫 equal，這樣可能出錯，但 MATLAB 通常只檢查

cues.en: for the first number of letters that are unique to that particular type.
cues.zh: 足以唯一辨識類型的前幾個字母。

cues.en: So we can probably even just get away with the E here.
cues.zh: 所以可能只寫 e 就夠。

cues.en: Yeah, and if we would write, you know, r, then we're gonna get an error because MATLAB doesn't know what vartype r is.
cues.zh: 對；如果寫 r，則會錯，因為 MATLAB 不知道 vartype r 是什麼。

cues.en: So the other option would be U for unequal.
cues.zh: 另一個選項是 u，代表 unequal。

cues.en: And then you see that actually changed, the numbers here changed slightly because the formula is going to be slightly different for equal versus unequal variance assumptions.
cues.zh: 數字稍有變化，因為等變異數與不等變異數假設的公式略有不同。

cues.en: Okay, so that's another illustration of the importance of choosing the right tail.
cues.zh: 這再次說明選對尾部的重要性。

cues.en: Now in nearly all cases, it's actually, it happens sometimes, but it's pretty rare that you really have a one-tailed test
cues.zh: 幾乎所有情況，偶爾有例外，但真的有充分理由做單尾檢定，

cues.en: that you are justified for doing.
cues.zh: 其實很少見。

cues.en: So nearly all the time it's going to be a two-tailed test in inferential statistics.
cues.zh: 所以推論統計中，幾乎一直做雙尾。

cues.en: Okay, what I'm going to do now is simulate a two-dimensional space of t-values.
cues.zh: 現在要模擬二維 t 值空間。

cues.en: So what I want to do is explore the relationship between the pooled variants, so the standard deviations of the two groups and their mean differences
cues.zh: 探索合併變異數，也就是兩組標準差，和平均差之間的關係，

cues.en: and what effect that has on the resulting t-value.
cues.zh: 以及對最終 t 值的影響。

cues.en: So I'm actually gonna run all this code and first show you the plot and then we can talk about this plot for a bit.
cues.zh: 先執行全部程式，展示圖，再討論。

cues.en: And then I'll go back and just highlight the important features of the code here.
cues.zh: 之後回頭強調程式的重要特徵。

cues.en: So here we have this two-dimensional plot of mean differences between the two groups on the y-axis.
cues.zh: 二維圖的 Y 軸是兩組平均差。

cues.en: So this would be the numerator of the t-test.
cues.zh: 也就是 t 檢定分子。

cues.en: And here is the pooled variance, the pooled standard deviation, I guess, on the x-axis here.
cues.zh: X 軸是合併變異數，應該說合併標準差。

cues.en: So the way you interpret this is this is showing a big matrix, this is visualizing a matrix, and each element of the matrix is the t-statistic
cues.zh: 這是大矩陣的視覺化，每個元素是 t 統計量，

cues.en: that corresponds to this as the numerator and this as the denominator.
cues.zh: 對應這個分子和這個分母。

cues.en: So not surprising, you see that.
cues.zh: 不意外，可以看到。

cues.en: And then the color is the t-value.
cues.zh: 顏色表示 t 值。

cues.en: So not surprising, you see that when the numerator of the t-value is zero, the t-test is zero.
cues.zh: 當 t 值分子為 0，t 檢定為 0，不意外。

cues.en: That's pretty obvious.
cues.zh: 很明顯。

cues.en: So there's never gonna be a significant effect around here.
cues.zh: 所以這附近永遠不會顯著。

cues.en: Now what's interesting is the relationship between the two axis.
cues.zh: 有趣的是兩軸的關係。

cues.en: So we see that when you have a mean difference of one, so your effect size, the mean difference between the two conditions is one.
cues.zh: 平均差為 1，也就是效果量、兩條件平均差為 1 時，

cues.en: Then whether or not the t-value is large or small depends on the pooled variance.
cues.zh: t 值大小取決於合併變異數。

cues.en: Now, that's not so surprising.
cues.zh: 不太意外。

cues.en: This is the numerator and this is the denominator.
cues.zh: 這是分子，那是分母。

cues.en: So obviously as the denominator gets larger, the ratio, the t-statistic is going to get smaller, which you see in these lighter colors here.
cues.zh: 分母越大，比值、t 統計量就越小，這裡較淡顏色顯示如此。

cues.en: So there's nothing particularly earth shatteringly weirdly complicated to understand in this figure, but I think it's interesting to look at it.
cues.zh: 圖中沒有什麼驚天動地、奇怪複雜的東西，但值得觀察。

cues.en: It shows you the importance both of the mean differences, so the numerator and the variance, which is the denominator.
cues.zh: 呈現平均差，也就是分子，以及變異數，也就是分母的重要性。

cues.en: So if you have a, you know, even a pretty respectably large numerator, you have a large difference between your conditions.
cues.zh: 即使分子相當大，條件間差異很大，

cues.en: If you have a large variance, you can still get a non-significant t-value, you can still end up with a relatively small t-value.
cues.zh: 變異數大時，仍可能 t 不顯著、t 值相對小。

cues.en: Now, I don't have the significance plot, so like, you know, what would be P less than 0.05 on this graph.
cues.zh: 這裡沒畫顯著性，例如 P<0.05 的區域。

cues.en: But, you know, you can imagine it's probably gonna be somewhere around here.
cues.zh: 但可以想像，大概在這附近。

cues.en: So values lower than somewhere, some line around here are gonna be significant, and values a above this line will also be significant,
cues.zh: 低於這裡某條線的值會顯著，高於另一條線的也顯著，

cues.en: and in between this is gonna be an area of non-significance.
cues.zh: 中間則是不顯著區域。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the upshot.
cues.zh: 這就是重點。

cues.en: Let me just walk you through very quickly how I created this matrix.
cues.zh: 很快說明如何建立矩陣。

cues.en: So here I define the mean differences, the pooled variances, and I'm fixing these group sizes.
cues.zh: 這裡定義平均差、合併變異數，固定群組大小。

cues.en: So it's also interesting when the video is over, if you want to play around a little bit with these group sample sizes to see how this plot changes
cues.zh: 影片結束後，也可以試著改群組樣本數，看看圖如何

cues.en: as a function of the sample sizes.
cues.zh: 隨樣本數改變。

cues.en: But don't play around with this too much, and that's because the next video is actually an unsupervised learning project that explores the role of n's in the two sample t-test.
cues.zh: 但不要花太多時間，因為下一部就是探索雙樣本 t 檢定中 N 作用的「非監督式學習」專題。

cues.en: Okay, so anyway, here I loop over the mean differences and I loop over the pooled standard deviations.
cues.zh: 這裡對平均差、合併標準差跑迴圈。

cues.en: And here is where I compute the t-statistic.
cues.zh: 這裡計算 t 統計量。

cues.en: And so I'm breaking this up here.
cues.zh: 分開寫。

cues.en: So here I compute the denominator as the pooled variance times the square root of of n.
cues.zh: 分母算成合併變異數乘以 n 的平方根。

cues.en: And so this is all just coming from the simplified version of the formula that I showed in the previous video in the slides.
cues.zh: 來自前一部投影片公式的簡化版本。

cues.en: And then here is the numerator.
cues.zh: 這裡是分子。

cues.en: So this is the numerator and then up hear is for the denominator, and then I'm computing the ratio, which is of course the t-statistic.
cues.zh: 這是分子，上面是分母，再計算比值，也就是 t 統計量。

cues.en: Now here I'm actually not using the ttest2 function, and that's because I don't actually have any data.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有用 ttest2，因為沒有實際資料。

cues.en: We're not simulating data, we are just simulating the numerator and the denominator to compute a t-statistic, a t-value without any actual data.
cues.zh: 沒有模擬資料，只模擬分子、分母，直接計算 t 值。

cues.en: Again, this is a good example of the power of using code to explore concepts and statistics without actually needing to go out and run experiments
cues.zh: 再次說明，用程式探索統計概念的力量，不需要真的做實驗，

cues.en: and gather a ridiculous amount of data.
cues.zh: 收集大量資料。

cues.en: It would be really difficult to produce a plot like this based on actual empirical data.
cues.zh: 靠真正實驗資料，很難做出這種圖。

cues.en: And then, so here I compute the degrees of freedom,
cues.zh: 接著計算自由度，

cues.en: and that goes into this term here, okay?
cues.zh: 放入這一項，好嗎？

cues.en: And so the degrees of freedom, of course, for a two sample t-test are n1 plus n2 minus 2.
cues.zh: 雙樣本 t 檢定自由度，當然是 n₁+n₂−2。

cues.en: And if you don't remember from the previous video why we have that n minus 2, then I encourage you to think for a moment about why the degrees of freedom
cues.zh: 如果不記得為什麼減 2，鼓勵你花點時間想想，自由度

cues.en: have to be this quantity here.
cues.zh: 為什麼必須是這個量。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm going to generate two distributions of data or two samples of data.
cues.zh: 現在產生兩個資料分布、兩個樣本。

cues.en: So the sample one has a mean of, or sorry, a sample size of 30 and the second sample has 40 elements in it.
cues.zh: 第一個樣本平均，抱歉，是樣本大小 30，第二個有 40 個元素。

cues.en: So slightly unbalanced two sample t-test here.
cues.zh: 稍微不平衡的雙樣本 t 檢定。

cues.en: Then we have the means of the two groups.
cues.zh: 這裡是兩組平均值。

cues.en: So this is the expected value or the population mean of group one and the population mean of group two.
cues.zh: 第一組母體平均、期望值，以及第二組母體平均。

cues.en: Of course, when we simulate these data, they're not necessarily going to have exactly these two means, and that's because we have, well, "sampling variability,"
cues.zh: 模擬資料時，不一定恰好得到這兩個平均，因為有抽樣變異，

cues.en: and I'm simulating sampling variability by generating normally distributed numbers and adding those to the mean.
cues.zh: 這裡透過常態分布數字加到平均值上模擬。

cues.en: And then here you see histograms of these two data sets using the Freedman-Diaconis rule.
cues.zh: 直方圖使用 Freedman–Diaconis 規則。

cues.en: Now, as I mentioned before, I generally don't recommend and I don't like using histograms to display multiple distributions on top of each other.
cues.zh: 前面提過，通常不推薦、也不喜歡把多個直方圖疊在一起。

cues.en: In this example, in this case, it happens to look pretty decent.
cues.zh: 這個情況剛好看起來不錯。

cues.en: And that's because there aren't, so there's only two groups and we have these, the transparencies in the plot and there aren't so many bins.
cues.zh: 因為只有兩組、圖有透明度，而且區間不多。

cues.en: So in this case it kind of works.
cues.zh: 所以這裡還可以。

cues.en: By the way, I'm getting these bars to be semi-transparent by specifying color using four numbers.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，使用四個數字指定顏色，就能讓長條半透明。

cues.en: So you're probably used to specifying color using three numbers.
cues.zh: 你可能習慣用三個數字。

cues.en: So that would be RGB.
cues.zh: 也就是 RGB。

cues.en: So this is pure red and this is pure blue.
cues.zh: 這是純紅，這是純藍。

cues.en: And then let me delete this 0.5 here.
cues.zh: 刪掉這裡的 0.5。

cues.en: So you can see here there's no transparency.
cues.zh: 可以看到沒有透明度。

cues.en: So in Python and also in MATLAB or just in, you know, color specifying on computers in general, if you supply an additional and optional fourth number,
cues.zh: Python、MATLAB，或一般電腦顏色指定中，如果額外提供第四個選用數字，

cues.en: that becomes the transparency.
cues.zh: 它就是透明度。

cues.en: So now these bars are 50% transparent.
cues.zh: 現在長條是 50% 透明。

cues.en: You know, you could set these to be 0.05 and now it's barely, barely visible.
cues.zh: 可以設為 0.05，幾乎看不見。

cues.en: You might not even be able to see data one on your screen, but anyway, let's get this back to 0.5.
cues.zh: 你可能連第一組資料都看不到，總之改回 0.5。

cues.en: Okay, now we know that the distributions from which these are the populations from which these samples were drawn have a true mean difference.
cues.zh: 知道這些樣本所來自的母體，確實存在平均差。

cues.en: They have a true mean difference of 0.2.
cues.zh: 真正平均差為 0.2。

cues.en: And I know that because I'm simulating these data, I'd specify that should be the mean differences, but that's not really apparent here.
cues.zh: 因為是我模擬的，指定差異就是如此，但這裡不明顯。

cues.en: And it's not really apparent because the standard deviation is actually five times higher than the mean difference.
cues.zh: 不明顯，是因為標準差是平均差的五倍。

cues.en: So the mean difference is 0.2, the standard deviation here is one.
cues.zh: 平均差 0.2，標準差 1。

cues.en: So that's five times more variability than there is a mean difference.
cues.zh: 變異程度是平均差的五倍。

cues.en: Okay, so that'll be interesting to see what is the result of our t-test here.
cues.zh: 看看 t 檢定結果，會很有趣。

cues.zh: 可以自己把順序換成 data2、data1，會得到完全相同的 t 絕對值，只是沒有負號，
